name: Fiendish Reflection

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

disable: DC 20 Religion check to exorcise the haunt, or DC 23 Intimidation check to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it with its own terror
reset: The haunt resets at the end of the round automatically, ready to trigger again the next tome someone looks into the water.

items.name: Frightening Visage
items.text:
Trigger A creature looks at the water

---
Effect The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of itself; it must succeed at a DC 20 Will save save or become Frightened 2 (and Fleeing for as long as it remains frightened on a critical failure).

text: Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish; a PC who views themself in these waters sees a distorted version of themself looking back at them, sneering and mocking.
